inspiration.purpose: Make one sentence develop into a selected benefit, with several mechanisms sustaining the same attention target.
beats: Letters arrive while the whole sentence settles from a larger view.
The early warm halo retires before the sentence finishes.
A small accelerating preparation leads to the sharp 1.25s reframe; final letters keep resolving.
Selection and three rays develop during the lateral settle.
A late retreat carries the readable word to the 2.05s foreground clear.

A simple message should stay active through coordinated detail rather than added copy.

technical.basis: Measured reference behavior and inspected local authoring scripts are listed separately below. All times are global seconds at 60fps; screen coordinates are normalized to 1280×720, x right and y down. Original software, project, font and exact source curves are unknown. This is the full documented breakdown of the current study, not a recovered source rig.

sections.title: Source timing and measured motion
items: The core opening is 123 frames. Frame 75 contains a large delivered-frame change; this does not prove an editorial cut, stepped key, or physical camera. Approximate blur/settle boundaries are softer than that exact frame boundary.
Thresholded screen-space bounds vary around 1–3px with glow and compression. Screen bounds combine all local/parent transforms and are not native Scale values.

sections.title: Native hierarchy and coordinates
items: AE uses a shared 2D null for camera-like framing. Letters, selection and rays remain independently editable below it; environmental fields have their own clocks. There is no recovered source camera.

The local font is Segoe UI Light, 54px with fixed tracking −25. The supplied sentence spelling is preserved for reference study. Prefix widths use sourceRectAtTime with a sentinel to retain spaces, preventing reveal-driven recentering.

code.label: Construction hierarchy
code.text:
Output comp: 1280×720 / 60fps / 16bpc
  FOCUS / sentence to easier
    TYPE <index> / editable character
    EASIER / fill + two rails + two handles
    EASIER / three rays
  ENV / independently moving padded light fields
  ENV / warm charcoal base

sections.title: Character arrival and shared entrance
items: Character index includes spaces even though spaces get no visible layer. This local schedule resolves earlier than the measured final-letter tail: retain it as current implementation evidence, not the corrected timing.

Shared entrance scale settles from 170% toward 95%; the 0.215s constant is a decay time, not the whole move duration. Position compensates the focus anchor and glyph center, so scaling does not swing the line away from its intended edge.

code.label: Common curve definitions
code.text:
u = clamp(u, 0, 1)
O(u) = 1 − (1 − u)^3             # cubic-out; fast start, long tail
S(u) = 6u^5 − 15u^4 + 10u^3     # smootherstep; quiet ends
a = globalTime − onset          # local age in seconds

code.label: Current character recipe
code.text:
onset(i) = 0.0295 × i − 0.035
opacity = 100 × S((t − onset)/0.085)
xOffset = 8 × (1 − O((t − onset)/0.12))
GaussianBlur = 8 × (1 − O((t − onset)/0.11))

code.label: Entrance before the later focus phase
code.text:
intro = 0.95 + (1.70 − 0.95) × exp(−max(0,t)/0.215)
              × (1 − S((t − 0.70)/0.35))
x = 220 − 250 × exp(−4.5t) + focusAnchorX × intro
y = 354.5 − glyphCenterY × intro
scale = 100 × intro

sections.title: Focus move: current mismatch and correction
items: The current focus blend uses cubic-out from 1.14–1.34s and targets 176% scale. Its separate lateral smootherstep runs 1.27–1.92s. It gets close too early, creates an early sideways smear, then accelerates again in the follow-through.

The source instead prepares gently, changes sharply at 1.25s and immediately decelerates laterally. Measured edge travel gives about 320→190→110px/s across successive 0.1s intervals from 1.4–1.7. Exact original Bézier handles are unavailable.

The documented correction is still a proposal: short accelerating preparation → sharp reframe at f75 → decelerating follow-through; final letters continue through ~1.33s and selection through ~1.80s. No revised native result is claimed.

code.label: Pending focus phase targets
code.text:
Preparation: about f68–74
Reframe: f75
Final letters: continue through about f80
Follow-through + selection: continue toward f108
Keep the liked glow, rays and late retreat.

sections.title: Selection geometry and late retreat
items: The current local selection starts at 1.20s and reaches full authored width at 1.52s; that is the known early endpoint, not the measured 1.25–1.80s reference interval.

Fill is (wordWidth+8)×53px at 52% opacity. Rails are 2.3×76px and handles 7×16px. Geometry uses the word-left anchor; the moving right rail/handle follows width progress. Retiming must preserve that alignment.
Exit scale multiplies the shared framing with an accelerating reduction from 1.75s. Foreground layers end at 2.05s; the source does not use a long opening-text crossfade.

code.label: Current selection and late exit
code.text:
selectionProgress = O((t − 1.20)/0.32)
fillScaleX = 100 × selectionProgress
rightRailX = wordLeft − 4 + (wordWidth + 8) × selectionProgress
exitMultiplier = 1 − 0.10 × clamp((t − 1.75)/0.29,0,1)^2.3
# Keep word-center compensation when applying the exit multiplier.

sections.title: Ray geometry, travel and contraction
items: Three rays share a 1.465s onset at −7°, 28° and 51°. Each is a 4.4×32px rectangle, anchored near its outer-tip construction. They travel outward while contracting into short dashes; an opacity-only fade loses the gesture.
Their ~0.275s local lifecycle occurs inside ongoing selection and framing. Three instances count as one accent system.

code.label: Final ray lifecycle
code.text:
g = O((t − 1.465)/0.075)
b = exp(−(max(0,t − 1.55)/0.063)^1.9)
scale = [100, 100 × g × b]
outwardTravel = 2 × g + 36 × (1 − b)
direction = [sin(angle), −cos(angle)]
position = base + direction × outwardTravel
opacity = 100 × S((t − 1.465)/0.018)
              × (1 − S((t − 1.685)/0.045))
outPoint = 1.74

sections.title: Fill color, bloom and moving environment
items: Native Fill Color animators replace the earlier invalid text-style expression. The first eleven indexed characters receive the warm pulse, returning toward off-white by ~0.37s. Earlier additive blurred duplicates are disabled in the glow-polish result.
The final glow pair has a 7px core and 26px halo, intensities 0.32p and 0.65p. Both follow the warm color; they are not the background light field.
Separate 2560×2160 padded AE ellipse sources feed the 1280×720 comp. Largest blur and transform need inspection after adapting dimensions; finite precomp bounds caused earlier rectangular artifacts.

sections.title: Files, versions and reproduction order
items: Use Opening-v02-glow-polish.aep as the liked glow/accent baseline. The later soft-word-arrivals joined AEP contains the documented scale/exit candidate and current easier mismatch; these versions are not interchangeable approvals.

Inspect the linked build → light → type/ray → glow → scale → exit scripts as construction history. They contain project-name guards, absolute workspace paths and one-time mutations; adapt controls into a versioned project instead of running the chain against whatever is open.
Local output is 1280×720 at 60fps, with native type motion blur, 100° AE shutter and 12 samples/frame. Broad smearing cannot be repaired by turning up blur when the speed curve is wrong.

For adaptation, recompute prefix widths and the easier anchor for the new font/copy. Adjust reveal duration, selection bounds and accent origin together. Compare the complete 0–2.2s passage and inspect f74/f75, final-letter resolution, selection growth and the exit boundary.
